``` For more than 20 years, through research, teaching and consultancy, I have worked at the interface between data, AI and power systems and markets. My core focus is how to generate optimal value for society from data. I combine mathematics and statistics with applications in meteorology, power and energy, logistics and business analytics, and my main contributions are in [forecasting](research/forecasting.qmd), optimisation under uncertainty and game theory: probabilistic energy forecasting, trading strategies for renewable assets, [electricity market design](research/markets.qmd), and [data markets](research/data-markets.qmd). I care about teaching as much as research. I have taught in French, English and Danish, and my video courses on YouTube, including the open course [Renewables in Electricity Markets](teaching/index.qmd), have been viewed around 300,000 times. In March 2026 I gave the DTU Ørsted Lecture, ["Can we predict the future of forecasting?"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tOe7jf_pcB8). ```{=html}
